configurations.name: web
runtimeArgs: lsof -ti tcp:3002 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null && { echo 'port 3002 is busy: reuse that server, or free it with clean-dev-ports'; exit 1; }; log="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.qa/web.log"; mkdir -p "${log%/*}"; exec > >(tee -a "$log") 2>&1; WATCHPACK_POLLING=true exec pnpm --filter @heliogrid/web dev

configurations.name: web-built
runtimeArgs: lsof -ti tcp:3002 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null && { echo 'port 3002 is busy: reuse that server, or free it with clean-dev-ports'; exit 1; }; log="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.qa/web.log"; mkdir -p "${log%/*}"; exec > >(tee -a "$log") 2>&1; pnpm --filter @heliogrid/web build && exec pnpm --filter @heliogrid/web start

configurations.name: clean-dev-ports
runtimeArgs: for port in 3002 8084 8081; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$port -sTCP:LISTEN); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "port $port: stopping $pids"; kill $pids; else echo "port $port: free"; fi; done
